name: San Mateo County Surplus Property Program
description: Free surplus office furniture, supplies, and equipment for San Mateo County-based nonprofits, schools, and cities
fullDescription: The San Mateo County Sustainability Department's Surplus Property Program offers retired County furniture, office supplies, electronics, and more at no cost to cities, schools, and certified 501(c) nonprofits located in San Mateo County before items go to public auction.
whatTheyOffer:
- Office furniture (desks, chairs, tables)
- Office supplies
- Electronics and other equipment
- Occasional "Shopping Days" to pick up items directly during large County moves
- All items free of charge for eligible organizations
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a city, school, or certified 501(c) nonprofit located in San Mateo County (nonprofits must email a current W-9 to SUST_Surplus@smcgov.org)
2. View listings at govdeals.com/SanMateoCounty, register for a bidder account, and subscribe to the Community Partners Tier
3. Request items for free while they are in the Community Partners Tier (or before an auction ends by emailing the item link)
4. Looking for something not listed? Submit the Reuse Request Form and the County will contact you if it becomes available
5. Your organization handles removal, packing, loading, and transportation
keywords: San Mateo County, surplus property, free furniture, nonprofit donation, office supplies, equipment, electronics, public school, county surplus
